title: Relay result: the opened unit at todoimpl/v1-e2e/requests/{rid}/result
description: Written once by the worker after the request is served (rtdb_relay's result node: kind names the request's kind). ok:true carries data, which is exactly the JSON body the matching HTTP route answers with HTTP 200 (minus its own ok key); RTDB keeps no empty object, so an empty data arrives missing. ok:false carries a code. at stays clear for GC.

kind.description: The request's kind as sent (also an unknown one, refused as unknown_kind); empty when the request did not open.

error.description: For the log and the copy-errors action; the app draws the code as a glyph (textgate).

retry.description: true only for codes a resend can fix: internal, upstream_unavailable, gave_up, rate_limited.

code.description: The first seven are the HTTP codes (common.schema.json#/$defs/error), same meaning. Relay-only: unknown_kind (not in the allowlist), unsealed (no _e2e blob, or it did not open), expired (sent_at older than 24 h), rate_limited (over 30 act requests a minute), too_large (data over 4 MB, e.g. a screenshot), stale_client (app older than meta.min_client), gave_up (3 claim attempts).

data.description: Per-kind shape. Action kinds: {task: task_card} as the HTTP action reply. Read kinds: the GET body. task_shot: {png_b64}. image_get (T2535): {data_b64, type} (a PNG: {png_b64}). live_watch, snapshot_refresh, notify_test: {}.

anyOf.description: credits_fallback, umbrella, umbrella_log, task_issues, tokens: the route's own body (umbrella.schema.json, tokens-*.schema.json).
